review: none: AI-drafted. The method tests each skill with two or more independently drafted sets and reports the spread between them instead of reviewing each set by hand.

queries.query: I want to make a skill that turns my meeting notes into action-item lists. can you help me set it up?
queries.note: User wants to build a brand-new skill from an idea.

queries.query: 帮我从零写一个 skill,功能是把 PDF 发票里的金额和日期提取到 csv 里

queries.clause: Run evals to test a skill

queries.query: compare token usage and time for old version vs new version of my skill, aggregate into a benchmark table
